description: Best swap route from Chord (getchord.xyz) across the DEXs of the chain, with the UNSIGNED transaction to sign, the ERC-20 approval it needs (as a ready transaction) and a simulation run from the taker wallet. Amounts are integer strings in the token's smallest unit; the zero address is the native coin. Nothing is sent: sign with your own key, then send_raw_transaction.

amount.description: Amount of tokenIn in its smallest unit, e.g. '10000000' = 10 USDC.

taker.description: The wallet that will sign. With it the answer carries tx + approval + a simulation from that wallet.

name: chord_swap_quote
title: Swap quote and unsigned transaction (Chord)
